environment.description: Kubernetes deployment on EKS. The RSA-2048 private key is stored as a Kubernetes Secret mounted at /etc/secrets/signing-key.pem. The same key file is shared across all pod replicas via the same Secret object. Key rotation is manual (operator replaces Secret and hits /rotate). No key versioning or automatic rotation policy. Service runs as root in the container with hostPID enabled for debugging. The signing key has been in use for 14 months without rotation.

config.container_security: privileged: false, runAsRoot: true, hostPID: true
config.secret_access: all pods in namespace can read the secret
